power.neoorigins.enderite_attack_bonus.d: E tuku ana i te 3 ngā whiu atu mō ia whiu.
origins.neoorigins.class_warrior.name: He toa
origins.neoorigins.class_warrior.descrip: He tohunga whawhai e kaha ake ana te patu, ā, e tu pakari ana i te tukinga whakamuri.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_damage.de: +1 pānga whakaeke ki ngā patu katoa.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_battle_st: +2 paruru māori  he iti ake ngā whiu a te toa.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_endurance: +1 ngā ngākau (+2 HP mōrahi) mai i ngā āwangawanga uaua i riro i te pakanga.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_iron_will: He ārai ki te ngoikore  kāore e taea e tētahi te whakaiti i tō kaha.
origins.neoorigins.class_archer.name: Archer
origins.neoorigins.class_archer.descript: He tohunga i te tawhiti me te whāinga tino pai me te mahi waewae ngawari.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_accuracy.d: Ka rere katoa ngā pupuhi me te tika tino pai  kāore he horahanga tūpono.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_agility.na: Ko ngā waewae o te waka
power.neoorigins.class_archer_agility.de: Ka tere ake te 15% i te mea noa.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_hawk_eye.d: He mārama ake te kite i roto i te marama iti  te taonga a te kaiwhaiwhai.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_arthropod_: Ko ngā pānga ki ngā rākau me ētahi atu arthropods ka whakaroa i a rātau mō te rua hēkona.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_starting_b: I whanau mai me te Mana e piko ana ahau.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_starting_a: I whakatipuhia ki te 16 nga pere.
origins.neoorigins.class_miner.name: Te kaimahi maina
origins.neoorigins.class_miner.descripti: He kaikauwhau mātanga e pakaru wawe ana i ngā poraka, e keri ana hoki i te kore e ngenge.
power.neoorigins.class_miner_speed.name: He tohunga mahi maina
power.neoorigins.class_miner_speed.descr: Ka tere ake i te 50% te pakaru o ngā poraka.
Ka pau te 30% i te hiakai i a ia e keri ana, e tūhura ana hoki.
power.neoorigins.class_miner_stone_fists: Ka wahia e ngā ringa tahanga te kohatu, pēnei i te kōhatu kohatu.
He mārama ake te kite i roto i te pōuri  ngā tau i raro i te whenua e whakaata ana i ngā kanohi.
+1 ngā ngakau (+2 HP mōrahi) mai i te anga pakeke o te kaituku.
origins.neoorigins.class_beastmaster.des: He kaihoroi kararehe, he ōrite te pānga o āu rongoā ki āna kararehe, ā, he roa ake te roa o āna rongoā.
power.neoorigins.class_beastmaster_diffu: Ko ngā pānga o te rēmana e riro ana i a koe ka tohaina ki ngā kararehe noho tata.
power.neoorigins.class_beastmaster_potio: Ko te Hoko a te Alchemist
Ka roa ake te 50% o ngā pānga o ngā rongoā katoa.
origins.neoorigins.class_explorer.name: Kairangahau
origins.neoorigins.class_explorer.descri: He kaihaerere mātanga e tīmata ana e rite ana mō te whakaongaonga, ā, he iti noa iho te ngenge.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_kit.name: Whakamātauria te Kōpae
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_kit.desc: Ka puta mai he kōpae ki tō tātaritanga.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_clock.de: I puta mai me te karaka i roto i tō tātaritanga.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_maps.des: I puta mai me ngā mahere kore e 9 i roto i tō tātaritanga.
Ka iti ake i te 40% te hiakai mai i ngā mahi katoa.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_sure_foo: Kāore he kino o te hinganga  e ako ana te ara ki hea ki te tau.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_climbers: Ka eke ki runga i ngā poraka katoa me te kore e peke.
power.neoorigins.step_assist_switch.name: Āwhina Taahiraa
power.neoorigins.step_assist_switch.desc: Ka whakahohe, ka whakahohe i tō pūkenga whakatikatika. Ko te tikanga ka eke koe ki ngā poraka mā te peke, pēnei i ētahi atu.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_campfire: Te okiokinga i te ahi puni
Ka āta whakahoutia i roto i ngā rohe 5 o tētahi ahi puni  anake i te wā e kore e whawhai ana (5 hēkona mai i te whiu whakamutunga).
origins.neoorigins.class_sentinel.name: Te Kaitiaki
origins.neoorigins.class_sentinel.descri: He tohunga ārai, he whakangungu māori, he tataramoa, he waewae pakari.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_thorns.d: Ka whakahokia mai te 25% o te whara i riro i ngā kaiwhakatuma.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_knockbac: 40% te ātete whakaheke  e tū ana ngā kaitiaki.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_iron_wil: He ārai ki te ngoikore me te puhoi.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_guard_en: +1 ngā ngakau (+2 HP mōrahi) mai i ngā karaka mutunga kore.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_guard_st: +35% atu ātete whakaheke i te wā e takahi ana (75% katoa)  whakapakari i te raina.
origins.neoorigins.class_herbalist.name: Kaitohutohu otaota
origins.neoorigins.class_herbalist.descr: He matimati matomato e whakatere ana i te tipu o ngā hua, e kokoti ana i ngā hua bonus, ā, e ārai ana i te mate.
Ka tere ake te tipu o ngā hua e tata ana ki a koe.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_harvest: He 50% ake te hua o ngā hua ina kohia.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_green_t: Ko ngā tono paraoa wheua e tipu ana i tētahi wāhanga anō.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_startin: Whakanohoia ki ngā uri witi hei tīmata i tō kari.
Te Tīmata i te Whakanui Bone
I whakatipuhia me te torutoru o te paraoa wheua.
origins.neoorigins.class_scout.name: Kaitiaki
origins.neoorigins.class_scout.descripti: He kaiarataki ara matatau, he tirohanga pō, he nekehanga tere, he tūpato hoki.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_night_visio: Ka mārama te kite i te pōuri. Whakapā atu ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.class_scout_speed.name: Te Whakatere Tere
power.neoorigins.class_scout_speed.descr: Ka tere ake i te 20% te tere o te tikanga.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_no_fall_dam: Kāore he kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_trackers_st: Ka eke ki runga i ngā poraka katoa me te kore e peke.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_trail_ratio: I whakatipuhia me tētahi paraoa paraoa mō te ara.
origins.neoorigins.class_berserker.name: Kaiwhakaputa
origins.neoorigins.class_berserker.descr: He kaiwhawhai haurangi e whakawhiti ana i te hiakai ki te mana raw whakangaro.
+3 kino whakaeke ki ngā patu katoa.
50% tere ake te hiakai  ka tahuna te pūngao e te riri.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_rage_wi: +2 te kino whakaeke ina iti iho rānei i te haurua o te hauora.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_reckles: -2 he whakangungu māori  ka wareware te riri ki te tiaki.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_thick_s: +20% resistance knockback  he iti noa iho ngā nekehanga a te berserker.
origins.neoorigins.class_titan.name: Ko te Titan
origins.neoorigins.class_titan.descripti: He kararehe nui, he hauora anō, he whānuitanga, he tino nui hoki.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_size.name: He whakamiharo
power.neoorigins.class_titan_size.descri: 25% nui ake i te kaitākaro noa.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_health.name: He kiri matotoru
power.neoorigins.class_titan_reach.name: Ngā Ringa Roa
power.neoorigins.class_titan_reach.descr: Ka taea te whakawhitiwhiti kōrero ki ngā hinonga i tawhiti atu.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_unmoving.de: +20% resistance knockback  e kore te titan e tutuki.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_heavy_steps: Ka neke 10% māmā ake  e taraihia ana te nui i runga i te haere.
origins.neoorigins.class_rogue.name: Ko te rākau
origins.neoorigins.class_rogue.descripti: He kaiwhakamate huna e huri ana i te kore e kitea i a ia e kopikopiko ana, ā, ka whara i a ia i muri.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_sneaky.name: Te Tūturu o te Tūturu
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_sneaky.desc: Kāore rawa tō tohu ingoa e kitea i roto i ngā pakitara, ā, he uaua ake te kitenga o ngā tinihanga i a koe.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_stealth.des: I muri i te hīkoi mō te 10 hēkona, kia kore e kitea. Ko te whakaeke mai i muri ka rua ngā whiu.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_soft_landin: Ko te haurua o te kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_parkour.des: Ka eke ki runga i ngā poraka katoa me te kore e peke.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_backstab.de: +2 kino whakaeke i te wā e piri ana.
origins.neoorigins.class_lumberjack.name: Kaitoi rakau
origins.neoorigins.class_lumberjack.desc: He kaitoi rakau e tapahi ana i ngā rākau katoa i te whiu kotahi, ā, e hanga ana i ētahi atu papa mai i ngā rākau.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_tree_f: Mēnā ka pakaru tētahi rākau ki te tao, ka taka te rākau katoa i te wā kotahi.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_bonus_: Mā te hanga papa mai i ngā rākau e rua anō ngā papa.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_axe_ha: Ka tapahia te rākau e ngā ringa tahanga, pēnei i te kōhao rino.
